items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 67:1
items.html: You already know that every lower one fills the vessels of the upper one that were emptied at the time the screen of the Guf of the upper one was refined, as stated regarding the Partzufim of AK. You also know that the Guf of the Partzuf of Keter of AK was already filled in complete fullness down to its Tabur, by its two Partzufim AB and SAG, and these fillings are called garments. It is thus found that from the Tabur and below, AB and SAG of AK were not sufficient to clothe it, since they are short garments that do not reach beyond the Tabur. Therefore the ten Sefirot of Nekudim came, and afterward the ten Sefirot of Atzilut, which clothe the TNHY of AK from the Tabur downward. Now, at first only the GAR of Atzilut came out, which receive from the corresponding aspect in AK from its Tabur and above, and therefore they are not yet considered true garments needed to fill the lights for the TNHY of AK, since only the ZAT of Atzilut, which are ZON, are alone attributed to the TNHY of AK. And this is the secret that after the first three Partzufim of Atzilut were completed, and AA too clothed in them down to the Tabur, like AK, AA saw that its NHY were exposed, meaning that within it there awakened the measure of the lack of light that had still not been completed even in the NHY of AK; and therefore it raised MAN to the upper ones, up to AB SAG of AK, from where the drop of Hesed descended that annuls the Parsaot, and raises the Rosh and Guf of ZON from BYA to Atzilut, and corrected them; and after its birth it descended and became a garment for the place from the Tabur and below of AA, by which measure the place from the Tabur and below of AK is likewise filled. (p. 914, Item 84)
